regime_context: The detector shows a narrowing (39% eligible) but still broad AI/tech-led tape with a confirmed leader in AI Infrastructure (not a one-narrative market; absorption is low at 0.31). Ranking is not alpha — cross-sectional momentum rank-IC is weak and rotation timing has no forward edge — but the absolute-trend gate HAS historically cut drawdown on US sectors, so trend-eligible names get a modest staying-power lean rather than a return forecast. Track record shows decent hit rate but near-coin-flip directional accuracy, so lean low everywhere.
emerging_watch: Watching Cybersecurity vs AI Infrastructure margin: the challenger (Cybersecurity, durability 0.84) is closing on a crowded, still-mixed-trend leader. I am not predicting a handoff — just watching whether CIBR sustains a relative-strength edge over SMH for three consecutive weeks; if that edge does not appear or reverses within that window, the handoff watch retires.

theses.subject: AI Infrastructure
theses.thesis: Highest cross-sectional rank with high breadth (0.917) and trend-gate eligibility; absolute-trend gate is the one validated risk-control leg, so the lean is for staying-power/avoiding a shake-out rather than expecting outperformance. Momentum rank is only a focus lens, so this is a modest directional tilt, not a conviction call.
evidence: gate_helps true — drawdown control is the validated edge
theses.dissent: Hurst tag is 'mixed' not clean trend, and leadership is heavily semiconductor-heavy (SMH proxy) — a single AI capex disappointment or memory/GPU oversupply would hit the whole complex hard.

falsifier.text: SMH closes below its 50-day moving average while SPY holds above its own 50-day

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Rank 2, genuinely trending (hurst 'trend', breadth 1.0) with the highest durability bar (0.84). But crowding_z 1.88 with crowded=true is an explicit size-down caution — I lean directionally positive but this is a cap-it-don't-chase-it name, not a buy because it leads.
evidence: crowding_z 1.88, crowded true — size-down caution only, not a fade
theses.dissent: Crowding flag means attention is heavy and a thematic ETF inflow spike historically marks tops; high breadth with high crowding can compress violently if the AI-risk trade unwinds.

falsifier.text: CIBR underperforms SMH by more than 5% over any rolling 10-day window before the check-by date

theses.subject: US Energy Complex
theses.thesis: Only non-tech theme in the top ranks that is trend-gate eligible with a 'trend' Hurst tag. Not crowded (0.63). The lean rides the validated absolute-trend gate for drawdown control on a diversifying theme rather than any momentum-based return forecast.
theses.dissent: Breadth is below 0.5 (0.455) — leadership is narrow, likely concentrated in a few large-cap producers, so the theme can look trend-eligible while most constituents lag.

falsifier.text: XLE closes below its 50-day moving average while the S&P 500 is flat or higher

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
